answer: At 28 units per epoch, sustaining 380 aliases for 58 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. The fee is charged through a ridge debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the thread totals, and the pulse anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
